blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Years had gone by since Joseph's brothers sold him. Down in Egypt, Joseph had been a slave, then a prisoner, and then, by the hand of God, the second most powerful man in the land. He had stored up grain through seven good years, and now the famine had come.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Back in Canaan, Jacob and his sons were running out of food. Jacob sent ten of them down to Egypt to buy grain. They came and bowed down before the governor, faces to the ground. They did not know it was Joseph. But Joseph knew them.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Joseph tested them for a while. He wanted to know if they had changed. And when Judah offered himself as a slave in place of their baby brother Benjamin, Joseph knew they had.

verses.text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

segments.speaker: narrator

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Joseph could not hold it any longer. He sent everybody else out of the room, and then he cried so loud the Egyptians heard it, and the whole house of Pharaoh heard about it.

verses.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

blocks.text: His brothers could not say a word. The brother they sold was standing in front of them with power over their lives. They were scared to death.

verses.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Now listen. Joseph did not pretend what they did was all right. He named it: you sold me. But he saw something bigger at work. God had sent him ahead to save lives.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: He told them to hurry home and bring their daddy and their families down to live near him, so he could take care of them through the famine. Then he threw his arms around Benjamin, and the two of them cried together. He kissed all his brothers and wept over them. And after that, his brothers talked with him.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Years later, after Jacob died, those brothers got scared again. They wondered if Joseph had only been kind because of their father. They sent word asking him to forgive them, and they came and fell down before him.

verses.text: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: You meant evil, Joseph said, but God meant good. Church, his forgiveness did not deny the harm. It held the harm and the hope side by side, and it chose to take care of the ones who had hurt him. He comforted them, and he spoke kindly to them. Somebody needs to hear that tonight.
